context: Mei helps Yumiko set up new pregnancy-tracking app on her phone.
purpose: small intergenerational tech help — bridging young to older

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: メイさん、この新しいアプリ、使い方、教えてもらえますか。
lines.en: Mei-san, could you help me figure out how to use this new app?
lines.style: Warm, slightly uncertain opening. Respectful reach-out to someone younger. A little self-deprecating laugh underneath. Genuine curiosity, no edge of frustration.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: もちろん。ここを、こうやって、押すんです。
lines.en: Of course. You press it here — like this.
lines.style: Patient and clear, leaning in slightly. Demonstrative on the action — 「here」 and 「like this」 come with gesture. Genuinely pleased to help. No condescension, just presence.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: なるほど、便利ね。最近、若い人のアプリ、難しくて。
lines.en: Ah, that's convenient. Apps these days — young people's apps are so complicated.
lines.style: Soft, appreciative laugh on 「convenient」. A little rueful admission that follows. Not complaining — observing with good humor. The warmth of someone who can laugh at herself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ふふ、私も、お祖母様のアプリ、わからない時、あります。
lines.en: Ha, I know that feeling — even I don't understand some of my grandmother's apps sometimes.
lines.style: Genuine, matching laugh. Slight lean-in on 「I too」 — conspiratorial warmth. Generous bridge-building without flattening the age difference. Kind deflection of praise.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Thank you so much. You're a lifesaver.
lines.style: Soft, settled gratitude. Slight sigh of relief underneath. The warmth of someone who has been genuinely helped and wants to acknowledge it. Small, real smile in the voice.
